messages.subject: Re: error in installation of Msstat from Skyline toolstore
parts: In the bottom of your error message:

The downloaded binary packages are in
    C:\Users\kguehrs.labadiville\AppData\Local\Temp\RtmpKkNGOM\downloaded_packages
trying URL 'http://cran.us.r-project.org/bin/windows/contrib/3.3/reshape2_1.4.2.zip'
Content type 'application/zip' length 571367 bytes (557 KB)
=======
downloaded 81 KB

This is an indication that reshape2 (a required package by MSstats) was not completely downloaded (81 KB < 557 KB). There may be some interruption during the download/installation process. 

Please consider to re-install again. Here are some instructions from a previous thread that might be helpful:
https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/msstats/tXFMHzys0fs
